utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any new updates yet, but I’m heading out on errands later and can ask around about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira — that’d be helpful. Let me know what you hear, and we can make a clear plan from there.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll ask around and see if anyone has news on the repair drive. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear something.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We’re still on track — I’m checking the last few donations and should have an update soon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks — just keep me posted when you’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, this repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, it’s still happening, but I want to double-check the timing and drop-off details first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — just let me know when the timing and drop-off are confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help however I can; just remind me what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren—could you bring any spare screws, a hammer, and some duct tape if you’ve got them?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing—I’ll grab any spare screws, a hammer, and duct tape if I can find them. If I forget, just give me a nudge when I head over.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the details for the repair drive? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I say yes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m a little fuzzy on the exact details, but I know it’s for helping fix up the neighborhood stuff, and I can check back with you soon.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — please check and let me know the details when you can. I’d like to confirm everything before I decide.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, I’m a little late—what’s the status on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries — we’re still on track, and folks are just starting to drop things off. I can give you the quick rundown if you want.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, please—quick rundown would help. I can jump in and start helping wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help out with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — could you bring a hammer, some screwdrivers, and a box of nails? If you’ve got a little time, you can also help sort the donated parts when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring the hammer, screwdrivers, and a box of nails, and I can help sort the donated parts when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m checking the repair drive location now so we can keep it straight.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — can you confirm the exact location? I want to make sure I’ve got it right for the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I don’t have the exact location confirmed yet, but I’m checking it now and will keep it straight for you.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s coming together nicely, but I haven’t seen the latest details yet.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, it’s shaping up well — I’ll send you the latest details as soon as I have them. You should come by; it’d be great to have you there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Aw, I’d love to—just send the details when you can, and I’ll see if I can make it!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time is the repair drive starting, Rey?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m not sure yet, Mina — I’ll check and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Rey. Just let me know when you find out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll help spread the word about the repair drive and keep folks posted on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate that. I’ll keep an ear out for updates and pass them along too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep people updated and make sure the plan gets around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’m putting the repair drive details in order now. If you’ve got any spots that need attention, send them my way and I’ll add them to the list.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’ve got one loose window latch and a dripping faucet I’d be grateful to get looked at.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Uli — I’ve added the loose window latch and the dripping faucet to the repair list. I’ll keep you posted on when we can get to them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m hearing the repair drive is still on for this weekend, so I’m planning to drop by and see what they need. If you want, I can ask around and bring you the details.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That would be great, Tess. Please bring me the details, and I’ll plan around them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll check in with folks and bring you the latest on the time, place, and what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m late — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — I just need you to help spread the word about the repair drive and keep the plan moving. If you can, remind folks to bring any small tools or spare parts they’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll spread the word and remind people to bring small tools or spare parts. Anything specific you want me to mention?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive if you need, Uli. What’s the next thing on the list?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. I’m still sorting the list, but the biggest need right now is tools and a way to haul materials.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can round up some tools, and I’ve got a cart I can use for hauling. Just tell me where to bring them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need me to bring or do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you bring the repair kit and meet me by the community center at 3?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep — I’ll bring the repair kit and meet you by the community center at 3.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds great — I’m happy to help connect folks and spread the word about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — could you share the date, time, and location too? I want to make sure we pass along the right details.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — send me the date, time, and location, and I’ll pass it along to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m a bit distracted, but I’m here now; what changed?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks for jumping back in, Noah — I was just checking whether we’re still on for the repair drive details. I’ll keep it quick and we can pick up where we left off.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yep, still on for it — I just need the latest details again.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any updates yet, but I can ask around while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Ira — that’d be a big help. If you hear anything, just let me know and I’ll keep the tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do, Gus — I’m heading out now, and I’ll let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Leo — what do you need help with for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help sort donations and load boxes if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’d be a huge help, Leo — thank you. Could you sort the donations while I line up the boxes?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a bit worried about the logistics—how many stops are we making, and do we have a clear route?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We’re keeping it tight—just the few homes that asked for help, and I can map a simple route. Do you want me to list the stops in order?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please list them in order so I can make sure the timing works.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, yes — I’m putting together a quick repair drive and I’d love for you to join us. If you’re free, I can send you the details right now.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, send them over—I can help keep track of supplies.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thank you—I'll send over the details and a simple supply list right away. Really glad to have your help keeping things organized!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup, but I’ll need the repair drive details first.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive details. I’ll grab them and send them over so you can help coordinate.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, send them when you can and I’ll line things up around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll keep the repair drive organized and make sure Nell has everything she needs.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I really appreciate that. Just keep me posted, and I’ll work with whatever updates you get.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course — I’ll keep you posted as soon as I hear anything, and I’ll make sure the updates stay clear and easy to follow.
